constraints: Only valid in the context of a form used as a subform; in any other context it returns Undefined.
If the subform container's data source is an expression, returns the expression's current value as evaluated since the last form event cycle.
If the data source is an array, returns the array index (an integer).

returns.name: any
returns.note: Type mirrors whatever the parent form's subform-container data source resolves to (scalar value, array index, or Undefined).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the current value of the data source bound to the subform container displayed in the parent form.
